snippet.title: House of Nowhere – Official Gameplay Trailer | Glassroot Interactive
snippet.description:
House of Nowhere is a multi-stage horror game where survival unfolds across a haunted house, a dangerous cave, and a hostile forest. each with its own threats, puzzles, and mechanics.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4279860/House_Of_Nowhere/?beta=0

Join the Community: https://discord.gg/zQd5cV9vt6

Gameplay captured from an in-development build. Subject to change.
